timeline.summary: Krenko surveys Sunhome from a rooftop and notes many dead soldiers loaded onto a Golgari corpse-hauler.
timeline.quote: Krenko began his surveillance on Sunhome, the imposing Boros guildhall.

citation.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: Branko guards kneeling Golgari prisoners in the basement corridor of the Detention Compound while the first floor is lost to a revolt.
timeline.quote: some of the Golgari overwhelmed their captors and gained control of the first floor.

citation.text: "The Shadows of Prahv, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2012.

timeline.summary: Gebris taunts a Golgari prisoner and presses his boot to the man's face, provoking the prisoners to hiss and growl.
timeline.quote: Gebris took the toe of his boot and shoved it against the man's face

citation.text: "The Shadows of Prahv, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2012.

timeline.summary: Gebris blames the Golgari for planning the raid, and Branko agrees to move the prisoners through the sunlit exercise yard to the South Block pens.
timeline.quote: "Let's take them through the exercise yard," Gebris urged.

citation.text: "The Shadows of Prahv, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2012.

timeline.summary: The prisoners surround Branko and free the gorgon to use her as a weapon.
timeline.quote: They were going to use her as a weapon.

citation.text: "The Shadows of Prahv, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2012.

timeline.summary: The gorgon tears at Branko's ear, the prisoners run free, and the guards lose control.
timeline.quote: Prisoners were running freely through the yard. They'd lost control.

citation.text: "The Shadows of Prahv, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2012.

timeline.summary: Vraska sings a Golgari song and talks with Jace before he falls asleep.
timeline.quote: The Golgari have little to be cheery about.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace's memory shows Vraska singing a Golgari song aboard her ship.
timeline.quote: this Vraska was singing a Golgari folk song at the top of her lungs as her crew cleaned the ship.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Vraska at seventeen is held by an Azorius guard, and Ludmilla is killed while calling to her fellow Golgari prisoners.
timeline.quote: And then, with a wet slice and a heavy thump, she was not. I was the only gorgon left.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Vraska leads the Phyrexians into the Golgari undercity, transforming her people into Phyrexians while Realmbreaker upends Korozda and cracks Svogthos.
timeline.quote: It is a hive in the truest sense, all pieces of a single purpose.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.
